title: A Uhlaka content file (uhlaka.content/1)
description: A site, or part of one, in one file: what `uhlaka import <site.db> <file>` and the import screen take. Made from src/core by tools/content-schema.ts; do not edit by hand. Every value is cleaned again by the program when it comes in: what this schema forbids is dropped there, not trusted.

program.description: What wrote it: `uhlaka 0.1.0`, or the name of the tool or agent.

theme.description: Taken only into a site with no pages yet. A theme is a document: start from one in themes/.

layouts.description: The site's layouts (ADR 0035). Leave it out for the ready ones.

slug.description: The address. '' is the home page (pages only).

published.description: What visitors see. Usually the same as `draft`; null or absent leaves it a draft.

items.description: Blocks written once and shown on many pages by a `section` block (ADR 0033).

types.description: Each kind of entry with its entries. `posts` is in every site; give it here to bring posts.

people.description: Who wrote the entries, as the site shows them. Never an account or a password.

comments.description: Approved comments. Usually empty in a new site.

orders.description: The shop's orders, as another Uhlaka site exported them (states: waiting, paid, preparing, sent, completed, cancelled, refunded). They name their buyers: never write them by hand.

media.description: Files carried in the file. A new site may leave it empty and use https addresses for pictures.

alt.description: For a picture: the words offered for people who cannot see it (ADR 0072).
What the picture shows, for someone who cannot see it.

header.description: The first row is the headings.

richText.description: Text as typed nodes, never HTML.

description.description: For search engines and previews; empty: taken from the words.

inMenu.description: In the menu the site makes while `settings.menu` is null.

translations.description: The page in the other languages, by language (ADR 0032).

seoTitle.description: The title search engines and previews show, when it differs from the title.

product.description: What an entry of a type that `sells` is sold at (ADR 0065 d2). Prices include VAT.

sale.description: The price it is sold at for now; below `price`.

anyOf.description: In grams: 500 is half a kilogram.

vat.description: One of the shop's rates; left out, the first.

counted.description: Its stock is counted: give it in `shop.stock`.

options.description: What it is sold in: `{ "name": "Size", "values": ["S", "M"] }`. At most 100 combinations.

variants.description: By combination (`M / Red`): its own price, sale, sku and weight, when they differ.

shop.description: The shop (ADR 0065): its settings, taken with the old site's settings; what is left of each product counted, and the coupons, brought into a shop that is on.

variant.description: A combination (`M / Red`), or '' for the product.

items.description: A code a buyer types in the cart (ADR 0065 d8). One coupon an order; it takes off the products, never delivery.

kind.description: `percent`: `value` from 1 to 100; `amount`: `value` is a sum in the smallest unit.

ends.description: The last day it is taken; left out, it does not end.

uses.description: How many orders may use it; null for no limit.

minimum.description: The smallest sum of products, in the smallest unit.

fields.description: Values for the type's fields, by key.

seoTitle.description: The title search engines and previews show, when it differs from the title.

sells.description: Its entries are products, each with a `product` (ADR 0065 d1). Only while the shop is on.

template.description: The type's own page as blocks; null for the default one.

slug.description: The address. '' is the home page (pages only).

published.description: What visitors see. Usually the same as `draft`; null or absent leaves it a draft.

consent.description: What the visitor agrees to, ticked before anything is sent.

settings.description: The site's settings (the `Site` of src/core/page.ts). Taken only into a site with no pages yet; what is left out keeps its default.

action.description: The one button in the header.

header.description: What the header shows besides the logo, the menu and the button (ADR 0085 d3).

bar.description: The slug of a section shown in a bar above the header, such as a phone number and opening hours.

cart.description: A link to the cart in the header, while the shop is on.

menu.description: null: the site makes the menu from the pages marked inMenu.

business.description: The business as a place people come to: address, hours (ADR 0061 d2).
